newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares jump 4.25 pct on political hopes.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares jump 4.25 pct on political hopes.

text.p: Istanbul shares leapt an average 4.25 percent on Monday morning amid hopes that a National Security Council (MGK) meeting will not produce negative results, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 XU100 jumped 66 points or 4.25 percent to end at 1,618. Morning volume also rose to 14.04 trillion lira from 10.70 trillion on Friday.
The MGK meeting began this morning amid a rift in the Islamist-led coalition government caused by the secularist military's demand to act against rising Islamist zeal.

The index lost 6.2 percent last week amid concerns which mounted due to the ruling Islamists' opposition to raise compulsory education to eight years from five as part of the measures put forward at the previous MGK meeting on February 28 to fight Islamist activism.
"Expectations that the subjects discussed at the February 28 meeting will not come up in today's meeting had a positive impact on the market," said Goksin Teker from Taib investment.
Some brokers said profit-taking could emerge in the afternoon.

Of the 239 shares traded, gainers outdid losers sharply by 196 to 10 and 33 were unchanged. The IMKB Industrial .XUSIN rose 2.9 percent to 1,598, the IMKB Services .XUHIZ jumped 3.74 percent to 1,444 and the IMKB Financial .XUMAL soared 5.5 percent to 1,785.
